findings.where: Hero action row, desktop and phone: the coral 'Email luc@mantahostels.com for launch news' button and the 'Explore destinations' outline button beside it
findings.fault: The two hero buttons are styled as if they came from different systems. The coral button is a full pill. The outline button has square, almost sharp corners and no fill, so it reads as a thin box drawn on the turquoise. The brand gives every button the same 8 px control corner, and an outline button a white ground. Here neither button follows that, and the two don't match each other.
findings.who_objects: The founder, who wrote down one corner radius for controls, so a pill against a square box in the most-viewed row looks unfinished. A visitor also sees two unrelated shapes for the page's two actions, which makes the hero look put together from parts.

findings.where: 'Where we're starting' section: the three destination cards (Canggu, Uluwatu, Kuta Lombok), desktop and phone
findings.fault: Each card has a hairline sand border plus a wide, soft, dark shadow while just sitting on the page. The brand says borders come first, keeps shadows for hover and popovers, and says nothing sits at rest under a heavy shadow. The sand-border edge alone already separates the card from the page. The extra shadow makes these three cards the heaviest surfaces on the page and looks dated.
findings.who_objects: The founder, whose rules name this exact treatment as a don't. A visitor gets a strong 'press me' depth cue on cards that look raised for no reason, which makes the calm sand section heavier than the hero.

findings.where: Hero at desktop: the manta mascot raised into the right half of the turquoise ground; on phone, its head and wing tips cross the wave edge onto turquoise
findings.fault: The mascot now sits mostly on turquoise. Its light blue and turquoise body nearly merges with that ground, so only its dark outline holds the shape. The brand rules ban the mark on a turquoise ground (1.20:1) and say that where it must appear in a turquoise zone it sits on a bounded ink form, such as the wave band, which is where it used to sit.
findings.who_objects: The founder, because this is an explicit 'Never' in the brand's do's and don'ts. Visitors see a washed-out mascot that looks like a faint shape rather than the brand's character.

findings.where: Destination cards: the region labels 'BALI', 'BALI', 'LOMBOK' above each place name
findings.fault: The region labels are set in small, tracked uppercase grey. The brand keeps uppercase for badges and filter labels only, and these are neither: they are plain place descriptors. They are the only uppercase text on the page.
findings.who_objects: The founder, whose casing rule keeps uppercase rare so it marks badges. A visitor wouldn't be confused, so this is polish.
